app_documentation:
The Flower Delivery App is a comprehensive e-commerce platform designed to streamline the process of browsing, purchasing, and delivering fresh flower arrangements to customers. The application serves as a digital marketplace connecting flower enthusiasts with a curated catalog of floral products, enabling seamless online ordering with real-time order tracking and secure payment processing. Built with modern web and mobile technologies including React for the frontend and Node.js/Express for the backend, the platform leverages PostgreSQL for robust data management and integrates with Stripe API for payment processing and SendGrid for automated customer notifications.

The app's main features include an intuitive flower catalog browsing system with category-based organization, detailed product pages with customer reviews and ratings, a dynamic shopping cart with quantity management, and a streamlined checkout process with delivery scheduling. Customers can track their orders in real-time through a visual status timeline showing stages from confirmation through delivery. The platform also includes a comprehensive admin dashboard that enables administrators to manage orders, update inventory levels, view analytics, and handle customer support requests efficiently.

The application is designed to serve three primary user roles: Customers who browse and purchase flowers, Administrators who manage the platform's operations and inventory, and Delivery Drivers who fulfill orders. The mobile-first responsive design ensures optimal user experience across web and mobile platforms, with accessibility features compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA standards. The interface employs a warm color palette with pink primary colors and green accents, reflecting the natural beauty of flowers while maintaining clean, modern aesthetics.

Intended users include individual customers purchasing flowers for personal occasions, gift-givers seeking convenient delivery options, event planners requiring bulk orders, and business administrators managing the flower delivery operations. The platform prioritizes ease of use, visual appeal, and reliable order fulfillment to create a delightful end-to-end flower purchasing experience.

glossary.Order Status: The current state of a customer order in the fulfillment workflow, including stages: pending (order received), confirmed (payment processed), preparing (flowers being arranged), out_for_delivery (assigned to driver), delivered (completed), and cancelled (order terminated)
glossary.Shopping Cart: A temporary storage mechanism that holds selected flower products with specified quantities before checkout, allowing customers to review and modify their selections. Each user maintains one active cart session that persists until order placement or abandonment
glossary.Product Catalog: The comprehensive collection of available flower arrangements organized by categories, each with detailed information including images, descriptions, pricing, stock availability, and customer reviews. The catalog serves as the primary browsing interface for customers
glossary.Payment Transaction: The secure processing of customer payment through Stripe API integration, generating a unique transaction ID that links the financial authorization to the order record. Includes validation, authorization, capture, and confirmation steps
glossary.Admin Dashboard: A privileged interface accessible only to administrators, providing comprehensive order management capabilities, inventory control, analytics viewing, and system configuration. Features include order status updates, stock level monitoring, user management, and reporting tools
glossary.Delivery Address: A validated physical location where flower orders are to be delivered, stored in the addresses table with complete details including street address, city, state, postal code, and country. Users can maintain multiple addresses with one designated as default
